## 📁 Folder Structure for New Projects

```
[Project Name]/
├── [Project Name].pbix           # Power BI Report File
├── [Project Name].pdf            # Documentation (optional)
├── data/                         # Data Files
│   ├── dataset1.csv
│   ├── dataset2.csv
│   └── dataset3.xlsx
└── assets/                       # Images & Screenshots
    ├── cover.jpg                 # Main project image
    ├── logo.png                  # Logo if applicable
    └── page[1-n].png            # Dashboard screenshots
```

---

## ✏️ How to Add a New Project to README.md

1. **Create project folder** with the structure above
2. **Add project section** to main README.md after existing projects
3. **Update "Coming Soon" section** by removing the implemented item
4. **Update Repository Stats** badge at the bottom (`Projects-[N]`)
5. **Commit changes** with descriptive message

### Code Snippet to Add to README.md:

```markdown
### [N]️⃣ [Project Title](./Project%20Folder/)

> **Context** | *Organization*

Brief description.

  <img src="./Project Folder/assets/cover.jpg" alt="Cover" width="700"/>

```

## 💡 Tips for Great Project Presentations

1. **Start with impact** - Lead with the business problem solved
2. **Show, don't just tell** - Use screenshots liberally
3. **Highlight technical depth** - Mention DAX complexity, data model decisions
4. **Quantify results** - Use specific metrics and KPIs
5. **Tell a story** - Guide viewers through the analytical journey
6. **Be honest** - Mention limitations or future improvements
7. **Credit sources** - Always acknowledge data sources and inspiration

---

## 📸 Screenshot Guidelines

For consistency across the portfolio:

1. **Cover Images**: 1400x700px, high quality
2. **Dashboard Screenshots**: Full page captures, 1920x1080px
3. **Detail Shots**: Cropped to highlight specific features
4. **File Format**: PNG for screenshots, JPG for photos
5. **Naming Convention**: `page1.png`, `page2.png`, `cover.jpg`, etc.

---

This template ensures consistency and professionalism across all portfolio projects!
